parsed.rationale: All three types — `MaterialBlendMode`, `PlaybackBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — live in the same `Wallpaper` package and each independently defines an identical `displayName` computed property at line 41 of their respective files. Introducing a `BlendModeDisplayable` protocol with a default `displayName` implementation in a protocol extension (e.g., in a new `BlendModeDisplayable.swift` within `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/`) would eliminate all three duplicate bodies. Because the property body is structurally exact across all three conformers, the default implementation can be provided unconditionally, and each enum need only declare conformance. This is the idiomatic Swift approach for sharing computed properties across unrelated enum types that share a common semantic contract.
